name: Asahel
overview: Asahel, identified as one of the three sons of Zeruiah and a nephew of David, was known for his remarkable swiftness, likened to a wild roe (2 Samuel 2:18). Demonstrating relentless pursuit and courage, he chased Abner without turning aside, even when urged to do so for his own safety (2 Samuel 2:19-22). His refusal to yield ultimately led to his death by Abner's spear (2 Samuel 2:23), highlighting both his bravery and the tragic cost of uncompromising zeal. Asahel’s story provides insight into the complexities of loyalty and valor within David’s military leadership.
